products.title: MidCentral IVP216 Uni-Pole Clamping IV Pole
products.body_html:
MidCentral IVP216 Uni-Pole Clamping IV Pole, Stainless Steel

This Uni-Pole universal clamping IV Pole is a really handy little tool to have.  It clamps to anything from an Operating table rail to a table leg or a bed rail and everything in between.  Designed to clamp to any round or square tube from 7/8″ to 1-1/4″ makes it a universal VI Pole.

It is constructed of stainless steel and aluminum, along with composite handles to make it easy to clean and ensures it will not rust or corrode.  304 stainless steel is resistant to rust and corrosion, even under the harsh environment of the operating room.

The main clamp of the Uni-Pole universal clamping IV Pole is what clamps the IV Pole to the table leg, bed rail or operating table side rail.  The second handle adjusts the positioning of the universal IV Pole.  The IV pole will adjust 360 degrees in pretty much any position you desire.  The third handle, part way up the pole, adjusts the height.  The pole adjusts from 18″ to 36″ in height.

The sturdy 2 hook top will easily hold most IV bags.  The ‘rams horn’ style hooks hold bags securely so they do not inadvertently fall off the hooks.  The all inclusive design ensures you won’t have to run around looking for the correct clamp or attachment for the IV Pole, it is all in one location, all the time.

Wherever, however, whenever you need an IV Pole, this Uni-Pole universal clamping IV Pole is a great solution.  It is small enough to fit basically anywhere, yet durable enough to stand up to the rigors of the demands of the healthcare environment.  Whether you are an anesthetist, pharmacist, floor nurse, ore pretty much any medical professional, there is a place in your environment that this small universal IV pole fits a need!

Features:

  • Stainless Steel construction
  • Unique clamp mounts to most surfaces up to 1 1/4″ diameter.
  • Adjusts from 18″ to 36″.
  • Extremely universal.
  • No need for additional clamps.

MidCentral IVP215 Rigid IV Pole, Stainless Steel

A rigid IV Pole that clamps directly to the OR Table side rail is a great addition to any operating room suite.  The anesthetist has one of the most important jobs during a surgical case, to monitor the vital signs of a patient.  It is integral to the success of the procedure that they have the best tools available.  Keeping their tools in great working condition is important to any facility who wants the best patient outcomes.

A rigid IV Pole that clamps directly to the OR Table side rail, is a great way to save space in the OR.  The space in an OR is very valuable and must be used wisely.  This IV Pole that clamps directly to the side rail, keeps the IV near to the patient and provides extra space for other machines used in the OR.  Another common use is when one IV pole is not enough for the volume of IV needed in a case.  A good example of this is also an arthroscopic procedure where a large volume of fluid is needed near the surgical site.  This IV Pole can be clamped anywhere along the OR Table side rail.

This rigid IV Pole clamps to the side rail with any clamp that accepts round accessories.  The versatile design makes it very easy for the anesthetist to configure the IV delivery to their liking.  The stainless steel construction ensures it is easy to clean and disinfect between cases.

The MCM215 is a durable and versatile design for any medical facility.  The stainless steel construction ensures it will last for a long time.

Features:

  • Durable and easy to clean SS construction.
  • Clamps to OR Table side rail with clark socket (sold seperately)
  • 2 easy on and off hooks.

products.title: MidCentral IVP270 Stainless Steel 5-leg spider IV Pole
products.body_html:
MidCentral IVP270 Stainless Steel 22″ Diameter 5-leg spider IV Pole

This 5 Leg spider base IV Pole was designed to maximize stability. Base is 22" diameter and has a low center of gravity with enhanced weight for added stability. 3" scuff resistant casters are standard for ease of mobility. Height adjusts from 50"-92" with no-lose thumb knob. Available in chrome finish or durable stainless steel finish. Different top options are available to meet your needs. Designed to hold several infusion pumps. Standard epoxy coated base color is charcoal.

Features:

  • 5-leg 22″ diameter spider leg base with low center of gravity for superior stability.
  • Base weighs 21 pounds and has 3″ scuff resistant casters for ease of mobility
  • 1″ diameter stainless steel pole adjusts 52″-94″ with no-lose thumb knob.
  • Base available in 5 different colors. Ideal for departmentalization.
  • Rubber bumpers on end of base legs to help protect walls and other objects from scuffing.
  • Available with 2-Hook, 4-Hook Top, 6-Hook Top and 8-Hook Top

products.title: MidCentral IVP251 Lift Assist IV Pole
products.body_html:
MidCentral IVP251 Lift Assist IV Pole, Height Adjustable

An IV Pole designed for the nurse! Eliminates lift bags up high and straining backs and
shoulders. Simply load the pole up with bags and turn the crank to raise. Adjusts in height
from 56"-96" just by turning the crank. Large 6 leg base adds the needed stability. 3" scuff
resistant casters provide unmatched maneuverability. Base post is 2" square stainless
steel tube with upper extension tube of 1 1/4" stainless steel tube. No electric motors or
hydraulic pumps to replace. Available with 4-hook, 8-hook or 28-hook top.

Features:

  • Eliminates Back Injuries.
  • Easily lifts heavy loads by simply turning the crank.
  • Height adjustable from 56″-96″ high.
  • Six Leg Base offers the stability you need.
  • 3″ scuff resistant casters provide unmatched maneuverability.
  • Base post is 2″ square stainless steel tube.
  • Extension post is 1 1/4″ stainless steel tube.
  • No electric motors or hydraulic pumps to replace.
  • Many accessories available: sold separately.
  • Available with 4-hook, 8-hook or 28-hook top.

products.title: MidCentral IVP286 Double IV Pole with Steering Wheel and Tray
products.body_html:
MidCentral IVP286 Double IV Pole with Steering Wheel and Tray, Stainless Steel

This IV Pole is designed for areas where several infusion pumps are needed such as ICU. Double poles make more spots to hang pumps and the two four hook tops make it easier to keep IV lines organized. Height adjusts from 85"- 110". Our 6 Leg spider base with 3" ball bearing casters make this a very stable and easy to move pole. Full circle steering wheel makes it easy to maneuver from any side. Complete pole construction is 304 grade stainless steel. Removable plastic tray makes a great place for storage and a spot to set things during bag changes and setup.

Features:

  • Height adjusts from 85″-110″
  • 3″ Ball Bearing caster
  • It helps keep IV lines organized to make it easy to change IV bags.
  • The full circle steering wheel makes it easy to maneuver even when it has many pumps and IV’s on it.
  • An ultra stable 6-leg spider base ensures that all will remain straight with the world no matter what you hang on the pole.
  • Stainless steel construction
  • Steering wheel is powder coated steel for longevity.
  • removable plastic tray for easy cleaning.
